metadata.title: Robinhood dip outlook: oversold but downtrend intact after Kalshi threat

content.text:
Investing.com -- Robinhood Markets Inc (HOOD) looks oversold, but the data doesn't yet show the selling has finished. The Kalshi headline is only part of the drop. A slump in crypto and a weak earnings reaction came first, so this is a stack of negatives and not a single shock.
Robinhood Markets Inc (HOOD): Trading at $72.16 (-7.32%, as of Nov 16, 3:27 PM EST) || Market cap $64.84B || 1M -27.02% || YTD -37.51% || 52W range $63.52–$139.75
Kalshi rattles the brokerage moat
-
Kalshi's move: The Wall Street Journal reported that Kalshi bought broker-dealer FB Securities in July. It plans to launch stock and ETF trading within about two months. Read more (Nov 16, 2026)
-
A crowded backdrop: Robinhood was already falling on broad crypto weakness before the report.
-
The Q3 miss: Crypto revenue fell 55% to $120M. Reuters reported EPS of $0.51 against a $0.55 estimate, though the call transcript cites adjusted EPS of $0.60. Read more (Oct 28, 2026)
-
Analyst view: J.P. Morgan called the legacy brokerage business strong in a "near-perfect environment for retail traders."
Kalshi is also a partner and competitor in prediction markets, since Robinhood's event contracts were up about 10% in October. A new rival in stock trading threatens fees and retail loyalty. Kalshi is still unproven as a stock broker, and it faces legal fights, including criminal charges in Utah. Read more (Oct 28, 2026)
Technicals say not yet
Daily readings as of Nov 16, 2026:
-
Moving averages: All 12 flash Sell. Price sits well below the 20-day (86.80), 50-day (102.26) and 200-day (91.27).
-
Oversold signals: The 14-day RSI is 29.15, and Williams %R is -93.6.
-
Trend strength: ADX is 30.5 with -DI at 39 against +DI at 16. That is a strong downtrend, and oversold readings can persist in one.
-
Levels: The 52-week low at $63.52 is about 12% below the current price. Classical pivot resistance sits near $78–$80.
Bull vs. bear
Bull case: Oversold momentum, a stock down 27% in a month, and a core business analysts still rate as healthy. A bounce toward the 10-day average (about $81) is plausible.
